text:
The motor vehicle registration shall be renewed:  车牌重新注册的时限是：(B)
A. every six months    每六个月B. every year 每年
C. every three years   每三年D. every month 每月

If your license is lost or stolen, you should: 如果你的牌照遗失或被偷，你应该：(B)
A. forget it 忘记它B. notify police 通知警察
C. get a new license 重新申请D. notify Motor Vehicle 通知交通局

When you got a new license plate, what must you do with the old one?  当你拿到新车牌照之后旧的怎么处理？(D)
A. throw it away 扔掉它B. sell it 卖掉它
C. give it to your friend 送给朋友D. turn in to Motor Vehicle 交予交通局，并要一张收据

Your car must be inspected at either a state inspection station or a state licensed private garage: 你的车在州检站或被州授权的私人车行车检的时限或行车里数是：(C)
A. every six months 每六个月B. every year 每年
C. every two years  每两年D. every 5,000 miles 每 5000 英里

At the time of your Road Test, you must present: 你在路考时，必须提供：(D)
A. a valid vehicle registration 有效的车辆注册B. a valid examination permit 有效的考试许可证
C. a valid insurance I.D. card 有效的保险卡D. all of the above 以上皆是

Unless otherwise posted, you should travel at when driving through school zones, business or residential districts.  除非另有说明，学校、商业区和住宅区的限速是(C)
A. 55 mphB. 35 mphC. 25 mphD. 50 mph

Getting a driver’s license illegally may result in a:  以非法途径得到驾照会导致：(D)
A. a fine of $25 to $100 罚款$25-$100B. imprisonment of 6 months 坐牢6个月
a court trial 上法庭
a fine of $200 to $500 and or imprisonment from 30-90 days 罚款$200-$500 并坐牢30-90 天

You cannot take your road test in a vehicle with any obstruction or consoles between the driver and examiner because: 在参加路试的车辆内，你和考官之间不准有障碍物是因为：(B)
examiner cannot observe your feet  考官无法观察你的脚
examiner cannot reach the brakes  考官无法使用刹车
console takes up too much space  占用太多的空间
obstruction is illegal  障碍物是非法的
The minimum age for a basic driver license is: 获取驾照最小年龄为：(B) A. 16B. 17C. 18D. 16.5

If you lose your license for drunk driving or any other violation, you:  如果你因为喝酒或其它原因而失去驾照，你将：(D)
can obtain a special work license 可以持一个工作执照
can drive commercial vehicles only 只可以驾驶商业车辆
can drive passenger vehicles only 只可以驾驶搭有乘客的车辆
cannot drive for any reason until the period of suspension ends and license is restored 不能以任何理由开车，直到吊销期限结束并重新得到驾照

If your driver license is lost or stolen, you should immediately notify: 如果你的驾照遗失或被偷，你应该马上通知：(A)
A. your local police station 当地警察局B. your local Motor Vehicle Agency 当地的汽车监理所
C. your closet Driver Testing Center 最近的驾照考试中心 D. your insurance company 你的保险公司

Special Driver Examination Permit may be issued at age 16 when: 在什么情况下，16岁时可以被授予“特别驾驶考试许可证”？(A)
the applicant is enrolled in a Behind the Wheel Driver Education Course of Department of Education
申请者参加由教育部门举办的“特别驾驶教育课程”
the applicant is enrolled in a Commercial Driving Education Course 申请者参加“商用驾驶教育课程”
purchased by an Approved Driving Instructor 合格的驾驶教练准许
all of the above 以上皆是

Your driver license is a:  你的驾照是一种：(B)
A. courtesy 恩惠B. privilege 特权C. obligation 义务D. honor 荣誉

If a person gets drunk in your home and has a motor vehicle accident, after leaving your home you could:
如果某人在你家喝醉酒，且在离开你家后发生车祸，你将：(C)
A. be charged with a crime 被刑事起诉B. not be held responsible 并无责任
C. become involved in a lawsuit 被卷入官司D. none of the above 以上全错

The first signs of alcohol impairment are usually: 饮酒后的直接损害表现于：(D)
talkativeness, increased self-confidence, lessened judgement 多说多话，增加自信，减少判断力
unconsciousness, no reflexes, lack of circulation 失去意识反映，缺乏应变能力
loss of balance, wild mood changes, slurred speech 失去平衡性情狂变口齿不清
increased reaction time, impaired memory, some muscular incoordination 反应迟钝，有损记忆力和控制力

If you drink beyond a BAC of .05%, the risk of your causing a motor vehicle accident doubles and at .10%, the risks increase to: 如果喝酒导致你的血液酒精浓度为 0.05%，你出车祸的几率增加一倍，如果血液酒精浓度为 0.1%，出车祸的几率便升至为：(A)
A. six times as great 6 倍 B. four times as great 4 倍
C. ten times as great 10 倍 D. three times as great 3 倍

You can get alcohol out of your blood by:  能使你血液中酒精排泄的是：(C)
A. drinking coffee or eating 喝咖啡或吃东西    B. taking a cold shower 冷水淋雨
C. time 时间D. vigorous exercise 剧烈运动

After two to four drinks alcohol begins to impair your: 饮两到四杯酒后，将会影响你的：           (D)
A. reaction time 反应时间 B. coordination and balance 协调与平衡能力
C. judgement 判断能力   D. all of the above 以上皆是

Studies show the great number of people arrested for drunk driving had been drinking: 统计所有酒醉被捕案例大多因饮：(C)
whisky 威士忌 B. gin 杜松子酒 C. beer 啤酒 D. cocktail of (wine) 鸡尾酒

The best way to reduce your chances of having an alcohol related accident is to: 最佳减少饮饮酒导致事故的方法是：(D)
A. reduce your drinking 减少饮酒量B. have a meal before drinking 饮酒前吃饱饭
C. know your own limits 了解自己的酒量      D. not drive at all after drinking 饮酒后绝不开车

If you drink four 12 ounce bottles of beer you will have about as much alcohol in your system as if you drank: 饮四瓶 12 盎司容量啤酒，相当于其他的酒是：(B)
A. 12 ounces of table wine  12盎司淡酒B. 1 drink of whiskey or gin  1杯威士忌或松子酒
C. 4 drinks of whiskey or gin  4杯威士忌或松子酒   D. 4 ounces of table wine  4盎司淡酒

Which of the following safe driving skills are affected by alcohol: 饮酒后驾车，你受影响的因素是：   (D)
alertness 机敏 B. judgment 判断 C. reaction 反应 D. all of the above 以上皆是

New Jersey law states that you may or may not be under the influence if your blood alcohol content is:新泽西法律规定，你血液中酒精含量在什么范围内可能不受酒精影响：                       (C)
more than .10% but less than .15%  大于 0.1%但小于 0.15%
more than .15% but less than .20%  大于 0.15%但小于 0.2%
more than .05% but less than .10% 大于 0.05%但小于 0.1%
all of the above 以上皆是

A 5-ounce glass of wine contains the same amount of alcohol as:  与一杯5盎司的葡萄酒酒精含量相同的是：(D)
A. one pint of whiskey    一品脱威士忌B. a gallon of wine 一加仑葡萄酒
C. a 6-pack of beer   六罐啤酒D. one 12-ounce can of beer 一罐12盎司的啤酒

If a driver has a BAC of 0.15%, he or she is times more likely to cause a crash.  如果一名司机的血液酒精含量为 0.15%，其造成交通事故的可能提高 倍。(A)
A. 25B. 10C. 20D. 50

Which is a tell-tale sign of a drunk driver?  什么是司机酒后驾车的迹象？(D)
A. weaving 摇晃B. quick stops 急停C. speeding 超速D. all of the above 以上皆是

Implied Consent Law means:  默认法则的含义是：(D)
you must have liability insurance 你必须有责任保险
permission for another to move your car in emergencies 同意别人在紧急情况下移动你的车辆
you sign an agreement to give blood 你签字同意献血
when you drive a motor vehicle you automatically agree to take a breath test following an arrest for a suspected drunk driving offense  当你被怀疑饮酒驾车时，你自动同意接受呼吸测试

A twelve-ounce can of beer has as much alcohol in it as:  与一罐12盎司的啤酒具有相同酒精含量的是： (A)
A. 1.5 ounce of 86 proof whiskey   1.5 盎司86度威士忌B. a bottle of rum 一瓶朗姆酒
C. 2 martinis 2杯马蒂尼D. a pint of brandy   一品脱白兰地

Which of the following drinks contain about the highest alcohol content?  以下哪一种饮料酒精含量最高？(D)
A. five ounces of table wine   5盎司葡萄酒B. 1.5ounces of whiskey/gin   1.5盎司威士忌/金酒
twelve ounces of beer   12盎司啤酒
all of the above are about equal in content 以上各种在含量上相当

In New Jersey, you must be at least years old to register a motor vehicle?  在新泽西州，你必须年满
岁才有资格登记开车？(A)
A. 17(provisional license)B. 16C. 15D. 21

For driving purpose you are on legal limit when amount of alcohol in your blood (BAC) reached what level?
根据驾车安全法规驾车者血液中的酒精限量是多少？(D) A. 0.5%B. 1.10%C. 90%D. 0.08%

A person who refuses a Breathalyzer Test in conjunction with a first offense for driving under  the influence is subject to:  拒绝酒精测试的第一次后果是：(D)
A fine of $50 罚款$50
A fine of $50 and six months loss of license 罚款$50 及吊销驾照6个月
Loss of license for 2 years and a fine of $250-$400  吊销驾照2年及罚款$250-$400
Loss of license for 6 months and fine of $250-$400  吊销驾照6个月及罚款$250-$400

In the state of New Jersey, a habitual offender is a driver whose license has been suspended or more times in three years. 在新泽西州，习惯性犯法是指一个司机在三年内被吊销驾照几次或以上。   (B)
A. 4B. 3C. 5D. 2

You can reduce your chances of being involved in an accident by knowing and using the standard accident prevention formula:  知道并应用以下哪些原则将减少你的事故概率？(D)
A. be alert 保持警惕B. be prepared 时刻准备
C. act in time 及时反应D. all of the above 以上皆是

To regain control while in a skid, you should:  当车辆打滑时，为重新控制车辆需：                (C)
A. make a fast turn 快速转弯B. keep tight grip on the steering wheel 把直方向盘
turn in the same direction the back of the car is skidding  向车尾打滑的方向打方向盘
make a fast turn in the direction of the skid and lock the brakes 踩住刹车的同时，迅速向车辆转动的同方向转弯

If a vehicle is passing you, you should:  如果后面有人超车，你应该：(D)
speed up so he will not complete the pass 加速使之无法超越
maintain your speed and signal 保持车速并打信号
flash your lights and sound your horn to warn the car passing you that is unsafe 开灯鸣笛警告不安全
Slow down to make it easier for the driver to complete the pass in time 减速使之容易超越

If your wheels drift onto the dirt shoulder of the road and you want to return to the paved road, you should:  当你的车辆压上泥质路肩时，你如何将车开会非泥质的铺设路面上来：(A)
slow down, turn back onto the pavement slowly 减速，缓慢开回铺设路面
drive along the shoulder until you are going as fast as the traffic 继续在泥质路肩上开，直到你的速度跟上其它车辆时开回
drive along the shoulder until you get to an acceleration lane 继续在泥质路肩上开，直到你开上加速车道
move slowly along shoulder and wave traffic around you 继续在泥质路肩上开，并向周围车辆挥手示意

If you are involved in a motor vehicle accident resulting in injuries while your driving privileges are suspended, you are subject to: 在驾照被吊销期间，因驾车导致车祸或人员受伤，你将被处以：   (C)
$25 fine   罚款$25
$50 fine  罚款$50
fine, suspension of your driving privileges and mandatory jail sentence 罚款，吊销驾照并监禁
additional 1 year suspension of your driving privileges 吊销驾照追加一年

The penalty for driving after your license has been suspended due to an alcohol or drug conviction is: 当你因饮酒或使用毒品驾车被停牌后仍继续驾车，则：(C)
$500 fine, a 90-day jail sentence and an additional loss of license for 5 years 罚款$500，坐牢90 天并额外吊销驾照5年
$200 to $1,000 and imprisonment for 45 days 罚款$200 到$1000，并坐牢 45 天
$500 and or imprisonment up to one year 罚款$500或坐牢一年
Loss of license indefinitely  无限期吊销驾照

Under the New Jersey Point System, a person having a license over two years, after how many points will get a notice of license suspension: 新泽西州罚分系统规定，驾车两年以上者，多少罚分将被暂吊驾照：(C)
A. 6 pointsB. 9 pointsC. 12 pointsD. 15 points

A person who hold a probationary drive license is subject to: 一个持有观察类驾照的人可能被： (D)
an advisory notice upon being convicted of their first moving violation 第一次违规，处以书面劝告
mandatory attendance at a driver education program in lieu of suspension for a second violation resulting 4 or more points 第二次违规，将强制参加学习班代替4罚分导致的暂时吊销驾照
any violation after attending school will result in suspension 参加学习教育后的任何违规，均将导致吊销驾照
all of the above 以上皆是

If you are driving an uninsured vehicle you are subject to this fine: 如果你的车没有保险的话，你会被罚：(D)
A. $100 and jail term   $100 拘役
B. $250
$500 with lawsuit  $500并被控告
$300 a term of community service determined by the court a one year license suspension $300及由法院决定时间的社区服务，并吊销驾照一年。

If a student driver commits a traffic offense, responsibility will be with: 如果一个学习驾车者违规，负责的应是：(D)
only the student 学员
only the instructor 教练
neither student or instructor 既非学员也非教练
both student and instructor 学员和教练

The first conviction penalty for driving while under the influence of alcohol or drug is: 饮酒或吸毒驾车的初犯处罚是：(A)
$250-$400 and possible imprisonment for 30 days $250-$400罚款并可能坐牢30 天（被取消驾照3个月至 1 年）
$1,000 fine and loss of license $1000罚款并失去执照
10 days in jail 入狱10天
loss of license indefinitely 无限期失去执照

Altering a driver’s license, or showing an altered driver’s license, may result in:  篡改驾照或使用篡改的驾照，会导致：(C)
a fine of up to $1,000 低于$1000的罚款
up to 6 months imprisonment 不多于6个月的监禁
loss of your driving privileges 失去驾驶权
all of the above 以上皆是

Which of the following will increase your chances of having an accident even if you only had one or two drinks:  即使只饮一杯酒，以下哪些因素与增加车祸可能性有关：(D)
A. your mood 情绪B. driving experience 驾驶经验
C. use of medication or other drugs 服用药物或其它毒品D. all of the above 以上皆是

The hand and arm upward signal means:  手臂向上的信号表示什么：(C)
A. slow 慢行B. left turn 向左转C. right turn 向右转D. stop 停车

If a passenger in the front seat (over 18 years of age) is caught not wearing a seat belt, who is held responsible?  如果前排乘客（超过 18 岁）因没系安全带而被抓住，谁负责？(C)
A. the driver 司机B. passenger and driver 乘客和司机
C. passenger 乘客自己D. all of the above 以上皆是

If a passenger in the front seat of a car, who is 17 years old, is caught not wearing a seat belt, who is held responsible?  如果前排乘客 17 岁以下，因没系安全带而被抓住，谁负责？(C)
A. passenger and driver 乘客和司机B. passenger 乘客自己
C. driver 司机D. none of the above 以上都不是

You may drive on public or private property to avoid a traffic or signal: 你可以驾车于公共或私人产地以避开交通信号，条件是：(D)
only if the driver stops the vehicle before crossing the sidewalk 只有在人行横道线前停下
only with permission of the property owner 只有在私人产地主人准许之下
anytime 任何时间
when directed to do so by police officer 当你在警察指挥下

When you move into New Jersey from another state, you must have your vehicle inspected within:
从外州搬到新泽西州，你必须在多少天之内去验车：(B)
A. 90 days after registering it 注册后90天B. 14 days after registering it     注册后14天
C. 6 months after registering it 注册后6个月D. 2 months after registering it   注册后2个月

What is a speed limit in a business district in New Jersey? 在新泽西商业街道驾车时速是多少？       (A)
A.25 miles per hour   每小时25英里B. 35 miles per hour   每小时35英里
C. 40 miles per hour   每小时40英里D. 55 miles per hour   每小时55英里

How close to stop sign are you permitted to park?  泊车应离停止信号多远？(D)
A. 20 feet   20 英尺B. 10 feet 10 英尺C. 45 feet   45 英尺D. 50 feet 50 英尺

MVS may terminate your road before it starts because of:  汽车监理所会停止你的路试，因为：      (D)
an unsafe vehicle 车辆不安全
a center console or other equipment in your vehicle that obstructs the examiner’s access to brake pedal 你车里与考官之间的障碍物引致考官不能使用刹车
missing seat belts 缺少安全带D. all of the above 以上皆是

When parking uphill on a street with a curb on your right, your car wheels should be: 当你在上坡且右边有路沿的街上停车时，你的车轮应该：(B)
turned to the right 转向右方
turned away from the curb 转离路沿（转左）（下坡转向路沿，转右）
turned straight ahead 打直向前D. turned toward the curb 转向路沿

Steady yellow light means:  固定的黄灯表示：(A)
traffic should stop before entering the intersection or crosswalk 在汽车进入人行横道前就停下
proceed with care 继续小心前行
wait for the light to change  等候变灯D. passing quickly 迅速通过

A flashing red traffic light means:  闪光的红灯意为：(A)
stop, proceed with caution 停车，小心前行
slow, yield to traffic on the right 减速，让右边的车辆先行
use caution when entering an intersection 小心进入路口
stop, wait for green 停车，等待绿灯

Driver approaching a flashing red traffic signal must:  驾车接近闪光红灯信号时必须：(D)
slow down at the light 减速慢行
drive carefully without stopping 小心行驶不必停下
merge to the light 穿过红灯
stop before entering the intersection 在进入路口前停下

The most common type of parking on city streets is: 在城市最常见的停车方式是：(A)
A. Parallel parking 平行停车B. Uphill parking 上坡停车
C. Angle parking 斜线停车D. Downhill parking 下坡停车

When parking on a hill, facing up or down, and there are no curbs, your wheels should be turned: 你将车停在小坡上，车头朝上或朝下，边上没有路沿时，你的轮子应该朝向：(C)
A. to your left 左边B. straight ahead 正前方
C. towards the edge of the road (your right) 路边（右侧） D. none of the above 以上皆错

In New Jersey, studded snow tires can be legally used between:  在新泽西何时可以合法使用“钉状雪胎”？(A)
November 15th and April 1st  在11月15日到4月1日之间
September 30th and May 30th  在9月30日到5月30日之间
April 1st and December 15th    在4月1日到12月15日之间
October 15th and May 15th    在10月15日到5月15日之间

When driving a motor vehicle you are required to have your driver’s license and your ? 驾车时你除了需要有驾照外，还要有什么？(B)
Title to the vehicle and registration 车主证明及车辆注册
Registration and insurance identification card 车辆注册和保险卡
Insurance identification card and certificate of ownership 保险卡及车辆所有权证明
Title to the vehicle and insurance identification card 车主证明及保险卡

Any changes of address must be reported to the Division of Motor Vehicles Services within what time period?  任何地址的变更必须在多长时间内报告给汽车监理所？(C)
A. 2 months 2个月B. 6 weeks 6个星期C. 1 week 1个星期D. 2 weeks 2个星期

Dim your headlights to low beam when:  何时使用近光灯：(C)
A. entering a curve 进入弯道B. driving on dark roads 在暗路上行驶
a car is approaching on a two-lane road  车辆接近双向车道时（只可用近光灯不可用远光灯）
parking on an unlit highway 停泊于无照明公路

You cannot park within how many feet of a crosswalk at an intersection?  你不可将车停泊在离人行横道多远？(A)
A. 25ft. 25英尺B. 10ft.10英尺C. 50ft.50 英尺D. 20ft.20 英尺

If you sell your car (and do not buy another) what should you do with the license plates? 如果你卖掉你的车（而不买另一辆），你该如何处理你的车牌？(C)
A. keep them as a souvenir 当做纪念品收藏起来B. throw them away 扔了它
C. turn them into a Motor Vehicle Inspection Facility or agency and ask for a receipt 把它交给车辆检验站并要一张收据D. give them to a friend to use 把他送给朋友使用

If two cars begin to enter an uncontrolled intersection at the same time: 如果两辆车同时进入一个无任何信号的交叉路口时：(B)
